wiki.title: Allison Russo
wiki.extract: Catherine Allison Russo (née Davis; born October 15, 1976) is an American Democratic politician currently serving as a member of the Ohio House of Representatives. She represents the 7th district, which consists of portions of Columbus, and Upper Arlington in Franklin County. Russo formerly served as Ohio House Minority Leader from January 2022 to June 2025. Russo also served on the Ohio Redistricting Commission.
